The לְ introduces the reference object of the preceding spatial expression; ASV renders that object as the house and the spatial expression מֵעַל as above, suppressing the additional linker under rule 40, as with סָבִיב לְ rendered round about its object. A three-morpheme fusion is possible, but the לְ adds no further direction or relation to this rendering beyond the independently rendered spatial compound.
